description: Ex-9 Squadron Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104A on a pole in the town of Safawi beside Prince Hassan air base. Construction number 183-1087, ex USAF 56-799, coded K. Spottingmode and the International F-104 Society both place it here. The Esri tile date for the point is 5 June 2025 but the airframe could not be resolved at the zoom available.
